text: At 79', Westport Albion implemented a tactical adjustment to protect their 3-2 lead by reducing their pressing intensity from 0.45 to 0.25 and dropping their defensive line equivalently, 0.45 to 0.25, signaling a deeper defensive block and slower tempo control (tempo 0.5 to 0.35) [#1459]. This positional retreat and press reduction triggered a rest-defense mechanism, decreasing high turnovers from 5 to 0 while increasing safe ball circulation reflected by box touches rising from 1 to 2 [#1459]. Consequently, Kingsmoor FC’s expected goals surged from 0 to 0.95, with higher field tilt and increased attacking entries, exploiting Westport’s lower PPDA (pressing intensity) which climbed from 3.9 to 5.8, allowing greater progressive passing opportunities [#1459]. Westport’s tactical shift fits their 4-4-2 direct style under Grace Oduya, prioritizing game management over aggressive pressing, effectively managing the lead despite increased opponent pressure.
